evidence.finding: The official getting-started guide lists public-preview desktop installers for Windows10+, macOS12+ and specific Linux distributions/architectures, and requires a GitKraken account. New-task workspace mode can be isolated worktree, new branch or current branch.

evidence.title: GitKraken Kepler agent-integrations
evidence.locator: Supported agents table; per-agent CLI commands; sign-in and account notes
evidence.finding: The exact integration table lists Claude Code, Codex, GitHub Copilot, OpenCode2, Pi, Auggie, Antigravity, Cursor and Grok Build with their executable CLI and chat/terminal modes. Kepler uses the users agent accounts without a model markup; Pi is terminal-only.

evidence.title: GitKraken Kepler tasks-and-resources
evidence.locator: Task resource model; What an agent can do; Starting and coordinating work; approval rules
evidence.finding: Native tasks retain resources and sessions. The kepler-workspace tools let an agent create tasks/worktrees, start delegate/reviewer sessions, read their conversations, send messages and receive reports through its inbox. Actions outside its owned work and higher access modes require user approval.

evidence.title: GitKraken Kepler automations
evidence.locator: Opening definition; Experimental gate; What it watches; Where it runs
evidence.finding: Experimental Automations start an Action or custom prompt on schedules or matching GitHub/Jira activity. A GitKraken sign-in and an open Kepler install are required. Each run creates a task with its own worktree, and own-activity suppression avoids some repeat triggers.

evidence.title: GitKraken Kepler remote-environments
evidence.locator: Two remote features; Local/SSH/WSL; Disconnect/server controls
evidence.finding: Remote environments execute agents/worktrees/terminals on a user-owned SSH host or WSL instance. Remote Access instead reaches an existing Kepler installation. Disconnecting a window leaves remote server sessions running; a browser client cannot manage host connections.

evidence.title: GitKraken Kepler review-changes
evidence.locator: Changes overlay; staging/commit; branch menu; comments
evidence.finding: The Changes overlay displays changed code, with per-line review comments, staging and commit controls. Branch operations include rebase and merge-from-target; those are separate from remote PR merge authority.

gitkraken-kepler:COORD-03.answer: Kepler supplies session_start for delegates/reviewers, session_read/session_send and a reports inbox within product-owned task/session context. A parent session can coordinate the work it starts. Every session gets kepler-workspace tools. Starting work in a more permissive mode or outside the agents owned task scope waits for user approval. session_send sends a prompt/message to another session or stops its turn. Out-of-scope sends require approval. inbox_read retrieves or waits for reports from sessions the caller started, and session_read exposes the other conversation.
